prompt: if MRR grew from $10k to $18k in 3 months, whats the monthly growth rate
text:
The monthly growth rate is approximately **22.4%**.

Here's the math:

$$\text{Monthly growth rate} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{18000}{10000}} - 1 = \sqrt[3]{1.8} - 1 \approx 0.224$$

This means MRR grew by about 22.4% each month on average over the 3-month period.

To verify: $10k × 1.224 × 1.224 × 1.224 ≈ $18.1k$ ✓
